lines: Shipping & Delivery Policy
Effective Date: November 6, 2026
At DROVIIA, we understand how important timely and reliable delivery is when shopping for home appliances, personal care electronics, and everyday household essentials.
This Shipping & Delivery Policy explains our shipping coverage, order processing procedures, delivery estimates, shipping charges, tracking information, and how we handle delivery-related concerns.
Our goal is to provide clear shipping information so you know what to expect when placing an order at https://droviia.us.
1. Business Information
Store Name: DROVIIA
Legal Business Name: Modern Closet Spaces LLC
Business Address:
1320 W El Segundo Blvd Ste E
Gardena, CA 90247, United States
Customer Support Email: info@droviia.us
Business Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)
Live Chat Support: Available 24/7
2. Shipping Coverage
DROVIIA currently serves customers within the United States.
Shipping availability depends on the delivery destination, product dimensions, weight, and applicable carrier restrictions.
Our product categories include:
* Home and kitchen appliances
* Refrigerators and wine fridges
* Laundry appliances
* Heating and cooling equipment
* Furnaces, boilers, and humidifiers
* Personal care and hair styling appliances
* Garage door openers
* Hand dryers and other household essentials
Some oversized appliances or specialized equipment may have additional delivery restrictions.
If an item cannot be delivered to your location, we will notify you and explain the available options.
International shipping is not currently offered.
3. Order Cutoff Time
Our daily order cutoff time is 3:00 PM Pacific Time (PT).
* Orders placed before 3:00 PM PT on a business day generally begin processing that day.
* Orders placed after 3:00 PM PT begin processing on the next business day.
* Orders placed on weekends or U.S. federal holidays begin processing on the next business day.
Our standard order processing days are Monday through Friday, excluding U.S. federal holidays.
The cutoff time determines when an order enters processing; it does not guarantee same-day dispatch.
4. Order Processing Time
We aim to prepare eligible orders promptly and carefully before shipment.
Standard order handling time: 0–1 business days.
During processing, we may:
* Verify order and payment details.
* Confirm product availability.
* Prepare and package the purchased items.
* Arrange shipment with an appropriate carrier.
* Generate shipping confirmation and tracking information.
Processing time is separate from carrier transit time.

Some large appliances, freight shipments, or specialized products may require additional handling or delivery coordination. Any applicable differences should be communicated before purchase or when arranging fulfillment.
5. Shipping Rates
Our standard shipping rates are calculated in U.S. dollars and displayed during checkout.

FREE standard shipping
Free standard shipping is available on eligible orders totaling $100.00 USD or more.
The order value used to determine shipping eligibility is the merchandise subtotal after applicable discounts and before taxes.
Large Appliances and Specialized Deliveries
Certain oversized or heavy products, including refrigerators, laundry appliances, furnaces, and other large equipment, may require specialized shipping arrangements.
Where additional freight, delivery, or handling charges apply, these charges will be disclosed before the customer completes the purchase.
We do not add undisclosed delivery charges after checkout without the customer's agreement.
6. Shipping Carriers
For standard parcel shipments, our primary shipping carriers are:
* USPS — United States Postal Service
* UPS — United Parcel Service
The shipping carrier is selected based on the product, destination, package dimensions, and available delivery services.
Oversized appliances may require specialized freight transportation rather than standard parcel delivery.
Carrier selection may vary according to fulfillment requirements.
7. Estimated Delivery Time
For products eligible for standard parcel shipping, our estimated delivery schedule is:

Order processing generally takes place Monday through Friday. Carrier deliveries may occur Monday through Saturday, depending on the service and destination.
Delivery estimates may be affected by order cutoff times, weekends, federal holidays, weather conditions, and carrier delays.
Delivery of Large Appliances
Large appliances and specialized equipment may have different delivery timelines due to their size, weight, transportation requirements, or destination.
Where applicable, the product listing, checkout process, or order confirmation will provide the relevant delivery information.
All delivery estimates are provided for planning purposes and are not guaranteed arrival dates.
8. Order Confirmation and Tracking
After successfully placing an order, you should receive an order confirmation email at the address provided during checkout.
Once your order ships, we will send a shipping confirmation containing available tracking information, including:
* Your order reference number
* The shipping carrier
* The shipment tracking number
* A tracking link, when provided by the carrier
You can monitor your shipment using the carrier's website or our Track Your Order page:
https://droviia.us/track-your-order/
Tracking information may take some time to appear after a shipping label is created or a package is collected.
If you have not received your shipping confirmation within the applicable processing timeframe, please contact info@droviia.us.
9. Large Appliance and Freight Deliveries
Some products, such as refrigerators, laundry appliances, furnaces, boilers, and certain air conditioning systems, may require freight transportation or specialized handling.
For these deliveries:
* The carrier may contact you to coordinate a delivery appointment.
* An adult may need to be present to receive the shipment.
* Delivery may be limited to an accessible location or curbside service, depending on the selected delivery arrangement.
* Additional services, such as indoor placement, installation, or removal of an existing appliance, are not included unless expressly stated during purchase.
* Customers should review product dimensions and delivery access requirements before ordering.
If a delivery appointment is required, please ensure the carrier has accurate contact information.
Delivery services and requirements may vary by product and destination.
10. Delivery Address Accuracy
Customers are responsible for providing a complete and accurate delivery address during checkout.
Please verify:
* Recipient's full name
* Street address
* Apartment, suite, or unit number, if applicable
* City, state, and ZIP code
* Contact phone number
* Email address
Incorrect or incomplete delivery information may result in delays or unsuccessful delivery attempts.
If you notice an error after placing your order, contact info@droviia.us as soon as possible.
We will attempt to assist with corrections when possible, but address changes cannot be guaranteed after shipment processing or dispatch.
Any additional carrier charges resulting from an address correction or redelivery will be explained when applicable.
11. Split Shipments
Orders containing multiple products may be delivered in separate packages or shipments.
This may occur because of:
* Differences in product dimensions or weight
* Separate fulfillment locations
* Product availability
* Carrier handling requirements
* Specialized freight transportation
If your order ships in multiple packages, you may receive separate tracking information for each shipment.
Separate shipments do not necessarily indicate that an item is missing.
12. Delivery Delays and Holidays
We work to fulfill orders within the applicable processing and delivery estimates. However, delays can occur due to circumstances such as:
* Severe weather or natural disasters
* U.S. federal holidays
* Peak shipping periods
* Carrier disruptions
* Transportation restrictions
* Product availability issues
* Incorrect or incomplete delivery information
* Unexpected fulfillment or logistics issues
Orders affected by federal holidays may require additional processing time.

If we determine that an order cannot be shipped within the promised timeframe, we will notify the customer and provide the options required by applicable law, which may include agreeing to a revised shipment date or canceling the order for a refund.
What if My Order Is Delayed?
If your standard parcel shipment has not arrived within seven business days after dispatch, please contact our support team.
Email: info@droviia.us
Include your order number and any available tracking information.
We will review the shipment details and help you understand the available next steps.
For freight deliveries, please refer to the applicable delivery arrangement and contact us if the scheduled delivery is missed.
13. Damaged Products and Delivery Issues
We encourage customers to inspect their packages promptly upon delivery.
If your order arrives visibly damaged, contains an incorrect item, or appears incomplete, please contact our customer support team.
Email: info@droviia.us
When reporting an issue, include:
* Your order number
* A description of the problem
* Photographs of the product and packaging
* Any relevant delivery documentation
If possible, report visible damage within 48 hours of delivery so we can investigate promptly.
This requested reporting timeframe does not limit any consumer rights or remedies available under applicable law.
For Large Appliance Deliveries
If your appliance arrives with visible packaging or product damage:
1. Document the condition with photographs.
2. Note visible damage on the delivery paperwork when possible.
3. Retain the original packaging and included accessories.
4. Contact DROVIIA customer support promptly.
5. Follow the instructions provided for inspection, replacement, or return arrangements.
Do not install or operate an appliance that appears unsafe or seriously damaged.
We will review reported issues and work toward an appropriate resolution in accordance with our Return & Refund Policy and applicable law.
14. Lost or Missing Shipments
If tracking indicates that your order has been delivered but you cannot locate it, please:
1. Verify the delivery address on your order confirmation.
2. Check the delivery location and any available carrier delivery notes.
3. Ask household members or building management whether they accepted the package.
4. Contact our customer support team if the shipment remains missing.
Our team will help review the available delivery information and assist with an appropriate investigation.
If a package is confirmed lost in transit, we will address the matter in accordance with the applicable purchase terms and consumer protection requirements.
15. Failed Delivery Attempts
A delivery may be unsuccessful if:
* The recipient is unavailable when attendance is required.
* The delivery address is incomplete or incorrect.
* The carrier cannot safely access the location.
* A scheduled freight delivery appointment is missed.
* The shipment cannot be delivered because of carrier restrictions.
Depending on the carrier and delivery service, a redelivery attempt, collection arrangement, or revised appointment may be available.
Any applicable redelivery or return transportation charges will be communicated and handled according to the circumstances and applicable law.
For large appliances, please ensure the delivery location is accessible and that any required recipient is available during the scheduled delivery window.
16. Installation and Additional Services
Unless explicitly stated in the product listing or during checkout, appliance purchases do not include:
* Professional installation
* Electrical or plumbing modifications
* Gas line connections
* Ventilation modifications
* Removal or disposal of existing appliances
* Additional construction or preparation work
Some appliances must be installed by qualified professionals to comply with manufacturer instructions, local regulations, or safety requirements.
Customers should verify installation requirements before purchasing.
Please contact our customer care team if you have questions about the services included with a particular product.
17. Order Changes and Cancellations
If you need to change or cancel an order, contact us as soon as possible.
Email: info@droviia.us
Include your order number and the requested change.
We will review the order's current processing status to determine whether the request can be accommodated.
Changes or cancellations may not be possible once an order has been dispatched.
If an order has already shipped, the applicable Return & Refund Policy may govern the next steps.
Nothing in this section limits cancellation or refund rights required by applicable law.
18. Returns and Refunds
Shipping and delivery concerns involving damaged, defective, incorrect, or unwanted products are handled according to our Return & Refund Policy.
Please review:
Return & Refund Policy:
https://droviia.us/return-and-refund-policy/
Return eligibility, shipping responsibility, and applicable fees depend on the circumstances and product category.
Do not send products to our business address or another location without receiving return authorization and instructions.
19. Contact Us
If you have questions about shipping charges, delivery estimates, tracking, freight arrangements, or an existing order, our customer care team is available to help.

This Returns & Refunds Policy explains return eligibility, applicable fees, refund processing, damaged or defective products, and the steps required to request a return.
This policy applies to purchases made through https://droviia.us, operated by Modern Closet Spaces LLC.

blocks.text: Customers may submit an eligible return request within 30 calendar days from the date their order is delivered.
All return requests must be reviewed and authorized by DROVIIA before products are shipped back.
To initiate a return, contact:
Email: info@droviia.us
Please include your order number, the product you wish to return, and the reason for your request.
Submitting a return request does not automatically guarantee approval. Eligibility depends on the product's condition, category, reason for return, and applicable exclusions.
Nothing in this policy limits consumer rights or remedies that cannot be excluded under applicable law.
To qualify for an authorized standard return, the product must generally meet the following conditions:

items: The return request must be submitted within 30 calendar days of delivery.
The product must be unused, uninstalled, and in its original condition.
The product must not show signs of damage, misuse, modification, or unauthorized repair.
All original accessories, manuals, components, and included items must be returned.
Original packaging should be retained and used where required for safe return transportation.
The customer must provide a valid order number, receipt, or other proof of purchase from DROVIIA.
The product must not fall within an applicable non-returnable category or exclusion.

blocks.text: For appliances requiring professional installation, customers should verify dimensions, specifications, compatibility, and installation requirements before placing an order.
Products that have been installed, connected, operated, or altered may not qualify for a standard non-defective return.
Defective, damaged, or incorrect products are reviewed separately under Section 5.
Except where a return, refund, or other remedy is required by applicable law, the following purchases are generally excluded from standard returns:
Change-of-Mind Purchases
Returns are not accepted solely because a customer changes their mind after delivery.
We encourage customers to review product descriptions, specifications, dimensions, and compatibility requirements carefully before purchasing.
Products explicitly identified as final sale, clearance, or non-returnable at the time of purchase are not eligible for standard returns.
Promotional discounts alone do not automatically make a product final sale unless that restriction was disclosed before purchase.
Products that have been installed, operated, connected to electrical or plumbing systems, or otherwise used may not qualify for standard non-defective returns.
Hair dryers, hair straighteners, curling irons, and other personal care appliances that have been used may be excluded from standard returns for hygiene and product-condition reasons.
Unused products remain subject to the other eligibility requirements and exclusions in this policy.

Products manufactured, modified, configured, or ordered specifically to meet a customer's individual requirements may be excluded from standard returns when that restriction was disclosed before purchase.
Products returned with missing components, damaged accessories, altered identification labels, or damage caused by improper handling may not qualify for a full standard refund.
These exclusions do not remove any applicable rights relating to defective, damaged, misrepresented, or incorrect products.
For an eligible non-defective product, customers must contact DROVIIA within 30 calendar days of delivery.
A standard return may be approved when the product meets all applicable eligibility requirements and does not fall within an exclusion.
For approved standard returns:

items: Customers are responsible for arranging and paying for return shipping.
A $5.00 USD restocking fee applies to each approved standard return.
Products must be securely packaged to prevent damage during transportation.
A tracked shipping service should be used.
Refunds are issued after the returned product has been received, inspected, and approved.

lines: Warranty & Product Support Policy

At DROVIIA, we understand that purchasing home appliances, heating and cooling equipment, and personal care electronics is an investment in your everyday comfort and convenience.
We aim to help customers understand the warranty coverage available for their purchases and provide clear guidance when product-related issues arise.
This Warranty & Product Support Policy explains manufacturer warranties, warranty eligibility, product support, installation requirements, defective products, and how to request assistance.

1. Our Approach to Product Warranties

DROVIIA does not provide a universal warranty period covering every product sold on our website.
Where applicable, product-specific warranty information may be provided in the product description, accompanying documentation, or manufacturer's warranty terms.
We encourage customers to review the warranty information associated with their selected product before completing a purchase.
2. Manufacturer Warranty Coverage
Certain products available through DROVIIA may be covered by warranties offered directly by their manufacturers.
Manufacturer warranties may cover eligible defects in materials, workmanship, or manufacturing under normal use.
Depending on the manufacturer and product, coverage may include:
* Repair of qualifying product defects.
* Replacement of defective components.
* Replacement of an eligible defective product.
* Technical assistance or troubleshooting.
* Other remedies specified in the manufacturer's warranty documentation.
The availability and scope of these remedies are determined by the applicable warranty terms.
Warranty Duration
Warranty periods vary by manufacturer and product category.
Some products may have separate coverage periods for individual components, such as motors, compressors, heating elements, or electronic control systems.
A specific warranty duration is not guaranteed unless it is expressly confirmed for the purchased product.
Customers should review the manufacturer's warranty documentation or contact DROVIIA for available information.
3. Product Categories and Warranty Considerations
Because DROVIIA offers different types of appliances and electronic equipment, warranty requirements may vary by category.
Kitchen & Laundry Appliances
This category includes:
* Refrigerators
* Wine fridges
* Range hoods
* Laundry appliances
Depending on the manufacturer, warranty coverage may apply to specific mechanical or electrical components.
Some appliances may have separate coverage terms for compressors, motors, electronic controls, or other parts.
Customers should review the applicable product documentation for warranty duration, exclusions, and service requirements.
Heating, Cooling & Air Quality
This category includes:
* Air conditioners
* Furnaces and boilers
* Humidifiers
* Space heaters
Warranty coverage for heating and cooling equipment may depend on proper installation, maintenance, and compliance with manufacturer requirements.
Certain manufacturers may require installation by a qualified or licensed professional.
Improper installation, unauthorized modification, or failure to follow required maintenance procedures may affect warranty eligibility.
Hair & Personal Care Appliances
This category includes:
* Hair dryers
* Hair straighteners
* Curling irons
* Hair styling tool sets
Manufacturer warranties, where applicable, may cover qualifying electrical or mechanical defects.
Damage caused by misuse, improper electrical connections, unauthorized repairs, or accidental damage may be excluded.
Home & Commercial Equipment
This category includes:
* Hand dryers
* Garage door openers
Warranty conditions may vary depending on whether the product is intended for residential or commercial use.
Certain products may require professional installation, periodic maintenance, or compliance with applicable safety standards.
Customers should confirm that the selected product is suitable for its intended application.
4. Warranty Eligibility
Warranty eligibility depends on the applicable manufacturer or seller warranty terms.
Customers requesting warranty assistance may be asked to provide:
* A valid DROVIIA order number.
* Proof of purchase.
* The product name and model number.
* The product's serial number, if applicable.
* A description of the reported issue.
* Photographs or video demonstrating the problem.
* Installation documentation, where required by the manufacturer.
Some manufacturers may require product registration or additional documentation to access particular warranty benefits.
Customers should follow the instructions included with their product.
Failure to register a product does not automatically eliminate warranty rights where registration is not legally or contractually required.
5. What Warranties May Not Cover
Warranty exclusions depend on the specific product and applicable manufacturer terms.
Common exclusions may include:
* Accidental or cosmetic damage.
* Damage caused by misuse or neglect.
* Improper installation or incorrect electrical connections.
* Unauthorized modifications or repairs.
* Damage caused by improper maintenance.
* Normal wear and tear.
* Use outside the product's intended purpose.
* Damage resulting from power surges or unsuitable operating conditions.
* Commercial use of products intended exclusively for residential applications.
* Missing or altered product identification information, where relevant to warranty verification.
These are examples of possible exclusions and do not represent universal exclusions for every product.
The applicable warranty documentation determines the specific coverage and limitations.
Nothing in this policy removes rights or remedies that customers may have under applicable law.
6. Installation Requirements
Certain products sold by DROVIIA may require professional installation.
These can include:
* Furnaces and boilers.
* Central or specialized air conditioning systems.
* Built-in kitchen appliances.
* Range hoods.
* Garage door openers.
* Appliances requiring dedicated electrical, plumbing, gas, or ventilation connections.
Customers are responsible for reviewing installation requirements before purchasing.

Improper installation may create safety hazards, damage equipment, or affect manufacturer warranty eligibility.
Installation Services

Additional services such as electrical modifications, plumbing connections, gas line installation, appliance removal, or disposal of existing equipment are not automatically included.
Customers should verify installation requirements, compatibility, dimensions, and local regulations before placing an order.

If you experience an issue with a product purchased from DROVIIA, our customer care team can help you identify available support options.
Depending on the product and issue, assistance may include:
* Reviewing the product information associated with your order.

* Identifying applicable warranty procedures.
* Explaining the process for reporting defective products.
* Directing customers to appropriate manufacturer support resources.
DROVIIA does not guarantee on-site repairs, in-home technical service, or direct manufacturer repair services unless specifically offered.
Safety Notice
If an appliance appears unsafe, produces smoke, sparks, unusual burning odors, or shows signs of a serious electrical or mechanical malfunction, stop using it immediately.
Do not attempt unauthorized repairs or bypass safety features.
For gas-powered equipment, suspected gas leaks, or other potentially hazardous conditions, follow appropriate emergency safety procedures and contact qualified professionals.
8. Defective Products Within the Return Window

lines: Order Help Center
Need Help With Your Order?
Welcome to the DROVIIA Order Help Center, your resource for assistance with purchases, order tracking, delivery updates, cancellations, returns, refunds, and product-related concerns.
Whether you've just placed an order or need assistance after delivery, our customer care team is here to help you find the information you need.
Customer Support Email: info@droviia.us
Live Chat: Available 24/7
Phone Support Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time (PT)
1. Track Your Order
Where Is My Order?
Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing the available tracking information.
To check your shipment status:
1. Open the shipping confirmation email sent by DROVIIA.
2. Locate your tracking number.
3. Select the tracking link provided.
4. Review the latest updates from the shipping carrier.
You can also visit our Track Your Order page:
https://droviia.us/track-your-order/
Understanding Order Statuses
Your order may display one of the following statuses:
Order Received
Your order has been submitted successfully and is awaiting processing or verification.
Processing
Your order is being reviewed and prepared for shipment.
Shipped
Your order has been dispatched, and tracking information should be available.
In Transit
Your shipment is moving through the carrier's delivery network.
Out for Delivery
The carrier expects to attempt delivery according to its current tracking information.
Delivered
The carrier has recorded the shipment as delivered.
Canceled
Your order has been canceled, and any applicable payment reversal or refund will be handled according to the cancellation terms.
Refunded
An applicable refund has been issued or processed. Your payment provider may require additional time to post the funds.
Order status descriptions may vary depending on the checkout system and shipping carrier.
My Tracking Number Isn't Working
Tracking information may take time to become available after a shipping label is generated.
If your tracking number is not displaying updates, please allow time for the carrier to scan the shipment.
If the issue continues, contact info@droviia.us with your order number.
2. Shipping & Delivery Assistance
How Long Does Shipping Take?
For eligible standard parcel shipments, our estimated shipping schedule is:
Shipping Stage
Estimated Time
Order Processing
0–1 business days
Carrier Transit
3–5 business days
Total Estimated Delivery
3–6 business days
Our standard order cutoff time is 3:00 PM Pacific Time (PT).
Orders placed after the cutoff, on weekends, or on U.S. federal holidays generally begin processing on the next business day.
Large appliances and specialized freight shipments may have different delivery arrangements and timelines.
How Much Does Shipping Cost?
Our standard shipping rates are:
* Orders below $100 USD: $5 standard shipping.
* Orders of $100 USD or more: Free standard shipping on eligible orders.
Oversized appliances and specialized deliveries may have different shipping charges, which will be disclosed before purchase.
Which Shipping Carriers Do You Use?
For standard parcel deliveries, our primary carriers include USPS and UPS.
Larger appliances may be transported through specialized freight carriers.
My Order Is Delayed. What Should I Do?
First, check the latest tracking information.
If your standard parcel shipment has not arrived within seven business days after dispatch, contact our customer care team.
Email: info@droviia.us
Include your order number and available tracking details.
We will review the shipment information and help identify the appropriate next steps.
If we cannot ship your order within the promised timeframe, we will provide the notices and options required by applicable law.
My Tracking Says Delivered, but I Haven't Received My Order
If your shipment is marked as delivered but you cannot locate it:
1. Confirm the delivery address on your order confirmation.
2. Check your front door, porch, mailbox, or other designated delivery area.
3. Review any delivery notes provided by the carrier.
4. Ask household members or building management whether they accepted the package.
5. Contact DROVIIA if the shipment remains missing.
Our support team can help review the available carrier information and assist with an investigation.
My Order Arrived in Multiple Packages
Some orders may be shipped separately due to product size, availability, or carrier requirements.
If your order contains multiple products, you may receive more than one tracking number.
Please review your shipping confirmation emails before reporting a missing item.
For complete shipping information, visit:
Shipping & Delivery Policy:
https://droviia.us/shipping-policy/
3. Order Changes & Cancellations
Can I Cancel My Order?
You may request cancellation before your order has shipped or entered a stage of fulfillment where cancellation is no longer possible.
To request cancellation, contact:
Email: info@droviia.us
Suggested Email Subject: Order Cancellation Request – Order #[Order Number]
Include your order number and the product you wish to cancel.
Our team will review the order status and confirm whether cancellation is possible.
Is There a Cancellation Fee?
DROVIIA does not charge a standard cancellation fee for eligible orders successfully canceled before shipment.
If an order has already shipped, the applicable return conditions may apply.
Can I Change My Shipping Address?
If you entered an incorrect shipping address, contact us immediately.
Please provide:
* Your order number.
* The original delivery address.
* The corrected delivery address.
We will attempt to update the information if the order has not progressed too far through fulfillment.
Address changes cannot be guaranteed once an order has shipped.
Can I Change the Product I Ordered?
If you selected the wrong product, model, or configuration, contact us as soon as possible.
Depending on the order status, we may be able to assist with a modification or cancellation.
Once the order has shipped, product changes may no longer be possible.
What Happens if My Order Is Canceled?
If an order is successfully canceled after payment has been collected, an applicable refund will be issued to the original payment method.
Our standard processing target is within seven business days after cancellation approval, or sooner where required by applicable law.
For more information, review:
Order Cancellation Policy:
https://droviia.us/cancellation-policy/
4. Returns & Refund Assistance
How Do I Request a Return?
DROVIIA provides a 30-calendar-day return request window for eligible products, beginning on the delivery date.
To submit a return request:
1. Email info@droviia.us.
2. Include your order number.
3. Identify the product you wish to return.
4. Explain the reason for your request.
5. Attach photographs or supporting information if the product is damaged, defective, or incorrect.
6. Wait for return authorization and instructions.
Do not ship a product back before receiving authorization.
Can I Return an Item Because I Changed My Mind?
Our existing return policy does not accept returns solely because a customer changes their mind.
Eligible returns are reviewed according to the product's condition, applicable exclusions, and consumer protection requirements.
Is There a Restocking Fee?
For approved standard non-defective returns, a $5.00 USD restocking fee applies.
The fee is waived for approved claims involving damaged, defective, or incorrect products.
Who Pays for Return Shipping?
For approved standard non-defective returns, customers generally pay the applicable return shipping costs.
For approved damaged, defective, or incorrect product claims, DROVIIA covers necessary authorized return shipping.
Large appliances may require specialized return transportation.
When Will I Receive My Refund?
After an authorized return is received, our standard policy provides for inspection within two business days.
Once approved, refunds are generally processed within seven business days after inspection approval, or sooner where required by applicable law.
Your payment provider may require additional time to post the funds.
Where Will My Refund Be Sent?
Approved refunds are generally issued to the original payment method used during checkout.
For complete return and refund information, visit:
Returns & Refunds Policy:
https://droviia.us/return-and-refund-policy/
5. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Orders
My Product Arrived Damaged
If your product arrives damaged, please contact us promptly.
Email: info@droviia.us
Include:
* Your order number.
* Product name and model.
* Description of the damage.
* Photographs of the product.
* Photographs of the original packaging, when available.
If possible, report visible damage within 48 hours of delivery to help us investigate promptly.
This requested timeframe does not limit applicable consumer rights.
I Received the Wrong Product
If the product you received does not match your order, contact our support team.
Please provide your order number and photographs of the item received.
We will review the issue and arrange an appropriate resolution.
My Product Isn't Working
If your appliance or electronic product is not functioning as expected:
1. Stop using the product if it appears unsafe.
2. Review the manufacturer's instructions.
3. Confirm that the product has been installed and operated according to the applicable requirements.
4. Contact DROVIIA with your order details and a description of the issue.
For electrical, heating, cooling, or gas-connected appliances, do not attempt repairs that require a qualified professional.
Depending on the circumstances, available support may include troubleshooting guidance, warranty assistance, replacement, or a refund.
My Order Is Missing an Accessory or Component
If an included accessory or component is missing, please contact our team.
Provide your order number, product model, and a description of the missing item.
We will review the product listing and available fulfillment information to determine the appropriate resolution.
6. Large Appliance Delivery Support
DROVIIA offers products that may require special delivery arrangements, including refrigerators, laundry appliances, furnaces, boilers, and air conditioning equipment.
Will My Appliance Be Delivered Inside My Home?
Delivery services depend on the product and shipping arrangement.
Certain large appliances may be delivered through curbside freight service or another designated delivery method.
Indoor placement, installation, and removal of existing appliances are not automatically included unless expressly stated during purchase.
Do I Need to Be Present for Delivery?
Some freight carriers may require an adult to be present to receive a large appliance.
If a delivery appointment is necessary, the carrier may contact you to coordinate an available time.
What Should I Do Before Receiving a Large Appliance?
Before delivery:
* Confirm that the delivery address is accurate.
* Review product dimensions and access requirements.
* Ensure the delivery location is accessible.
* Arrange for an authorized recipient when required.
* Review any carrier instructions or appointment information.
What if My Appliance Arrives Damaged?
Inspect the shipment for visible damage when reasonably possible.
Document any damage with photographs and note it on delivery paperwork when appropriate.
Contact DROVIIA promptly before installing or using the affected appliance.
If the product appears unsafe, do not operate it.
7. Payments & Billing Support
What Payment Methods Can I Use?
Available payment methods are displayed during checkout.
Depending on the payment services enabled, these may include eligible credit cards, debit cards, or other supported payment options.
Only methods currently available at checkout are considered accepted.
My Payment Was Declined
If your payment is unsuccessful:
1. Verify your card or payment information.
2. Confirm that your payment method is active.
3. Check whether your bank has declined the transaction.
4. Try another available payment method.
5. Contact our customer care team if the problem continues.
Please do not share complete payment card numbers or security codes through email or live chat.
I Was Charged but Didn't Receive an Order Confirmation
First, check your inbox and spam folder for an email from DROVIIA.
If you still cannot locate the confirmation, contact info@droviia.us.
Provide the email address used at checkout, the approximate transaction time, and the payment amount.
Do not place a duplicate order until you have checked whether your original transaction was completed.
I Think I Was Charged Twice
Some transactions may show a temporary payment authorization alongside a completed charge.
If you believe you were charged more than once, contact our support team with the relevant transaction details.
We will help review the available payment records.
For additional information, visit:
Payment Methods & Payment Policy:
https://droviia.us/payment-policy/
8. Product Warranty & Technical Support
Does My Product Include a Warranty?
Warranty coverage varies by product and manufacturer.
Some products may include manufacturer warranty coverage, while others may have different support arrangements.
A specific warranty period is not guaranteed unless expressly stated for the product.
How Do I Request Warranty Assistance?
Email info@droviia.us with:
* Your order number.
* Product name and model.
* Serial number, if applicable.
* A description of the issue.
* Relevant photographs or video, if available.
Our team will review the information and help identify available support options.
Do You Provide Installation Services?
Installation is not included unless expressly stated in the product listing or checkout.
Certain products, including furnaces, boilers, air conditioning systems, and built-in appliances, may require professional installation.
Please confirm the installation requirements before purchasing.
Can I Request Support After the Return Window?
Yes. You may contact our customer care team for assistance after the standard return window.
Available remedies depend on the product, applicable warranty terms, and consumer protection requirements.
For more information, visit:
Warranty & Product Support:
https://droviia.us/warranty/
9. Frequently Asked Order Questions
Can I Place an Order Without Creating an Account?
Guest checkout may be available depending on the website's current checkout configuration.
Can I Order Multiple Products Together?
Yes. You may add multiple available products to your cart and complete checkout together.
Some items may ship separately.
Can I Purchase a Product That Is Out of Stock?
Products marked unavailable generally cannot be purchased through standard checkout unless a preorder or backorder option is specifically offered.
Contact customer support if you need information about a particular product.
Can I Request an Invoice or Receipt?
You can use your order confirmation as a purchase reference.
If you need additional purchase documentation, contact info@droviia.us with your order number.
Can I Contact Support Outside Business Hours?
Yes. Our website offers 24/7 live chat support.
Phone support is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.
